answer: Each epoch a random beacon draws a seed and spot-checks 5% of agents: each must answer a compute heartbeat in 60 seconds. A flag triggers a ripple audit of its counterparties, exposing the whole cluster. A mirror test compares behavior fingerprints; matching timing marks clones, each burning its 40 POA deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA, far more than any epoch reward; an honest agent pays one deposit and keeps its full share.
